cards.front: What should you know about art, craft and design exam tips?
cards.back: Start preparation IMMEDIATELY after receiving the paper — do not waste time. Address ALL FOUR AOs in your preparatory work. Plan your 10 hours carefully — create a schedule. Test materials and techniques BEFORE the supervised time. Your preparation folder is MARKED — make it as strong as your portfolio.

Students often make mistakes with this topic. Wrong: The ESA is an exam where you just make art for 10 hours with no preparation. Correct: The ESA has two parts: a PREPARATORY PERIOD (weeks of research, development and experimentation — like a mini-portfolio) and the 10 HOURS SUPERVISED TIME (where you create your final response).
